name: M & P Auto Parts
old_description: We have been serving the Auburn community since 1977 with the finest new and used car parts, ensuring absolute customer satisfaction. Our professional team offers years of experience and will help you find the right component to suit your needs. We carry a variety of used car parts, accessories and tools for foreign and domestic autos with exceptional value and service – all with the goal of being the top source for auto parts in the Auburn area.
about:
Founded in 1977 in Auburn, Maine, M & P Auto Parts has spent decades serving the region from its facility on Merrow Road. The business began as a local auto parts supplier and grew into a full-service salvage yard that purchases, dismantles, and resells functional components from both working and nonworking vehicles.

The company operates a salvage yard that stocks new and used auto parts for foreign and domestic cars and trucks, including items such as air pumps, carburetors, fenders, headlights, rear doors, and trunk lids. It also provides junk car removal — available only in the Auburn and Lewiston areas — and offers an online multi-part search tool for customers to locate inventory. A 90-day warranty covers mechanical parts, while electrical parts carry a 30-day warranty.

M & P Auto Parts serves individual vehicle owners, repair shops, and classic-car enthusiasts across a wide swath of central and southern Maine. Its service area includes Auburn, Lewiston, Portland, Augusta, Waterville, Brunswick, Sanford, Scarborough, Biddeford, Bangor, and surrounding communities. The yard caters to those needing affordable replacement parts for everything from daily drivers to rare classic vehicles.

Membership in the Maine Auto Recyclers Association certifies the operation to perform junk car removal to state standards, and the company emphasizes community relationships and positive customer interactions as core to its approach.
